admission_requirements.general_requirements: General Secondary Education Certificate (Tawjihi) or equivalent; parallel program requires minimum 65% average; bridging students from community colleges need 68% in comprehensive exam (70% for engineering)
admission_requirements.exam_details: English proficiency examination for all students; those scoring below 70% must take remedial English course. Arabic and computer level examinations also required.
admission_requirements.english_requirement: English proficiency examination required; score of 70% or above exempts student from English 101 remedial course

major_categories: institute of astronomy and space sciences

tuition_fees.annual_fees_range: 330-3,240 JOD per year estimated (10-80 JOD per credit hour depending on program and track; regular/parallel/international)
tuition_fees.notes: Regular program: 10 JOD/credit hour for humanities, 12 for sciences, 20 for nursing and architecture, 30 for IT and engineering. Parallel program: 30-80 JOD/credit hour. International parallel: 60-125 JOD/credit hour. One-time admission fee 140 JOD (regular), 210 JOD (parallel). Quarterly service fees 40 JOD (regular), 100 JOD (parallel). Renewable energy engineering has highest fees.

ranking_accreditation.accreditation: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research of Jordan; Accreditation and Quality Assurance Commission For Higher Education Institutions
ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: THE World University Rankings 801-1000th (2026); THE Arab University Ranking 121st (2024); SCImago World Ranking 6113th (2026); Webometrics World Ranking 2804th (2024)

market_demand.notes: University actively aligning programs with labor market needs through EUSEEDS project (EU-funded) and partnerships with USAID. Jordan's national youth unemployment exceeds 50%, making accurate university-specific employment data unavailable. University has introduced market-responsive programs in cybersecurity, data science, AI, and financial technology.

campus_facilities.accommodation_details: University housing for female students only in five dormitories with capacity of approximately 500 students. No on-campus housing for male students. Housing fees: 105 JOD per semester (regular), 55 JOD (summer session). Housing deposit: 25 JOD.
campus_facilities.scholarship_details: Academic excellence scholarships (at least one per class per major); teaching assistant scholarships for master's students (renewable up to 5 semesters); MOHE postgraduate scholarships; Tawjihi top achiever full scholarships; Syrian refugee scholarships (UNHCR-supported); international partnerships (USAID, Erasmus+). Student loans available through the Student Fund.
